message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is an action card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), treat it as if it had been played by the dealer. | | **2. Turn Order** | • Play proceeds clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if a Reverse card is played).
• The player to the left of the dealer starts. | • A Reverse card flips the direction of play. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four card at any time. | • If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. | | **4. Drawing a Card** | • If you draw a card that can be played immediately, you may play it right away.
• If you cannot play the drawn card, your turn ends. | • If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | **5. Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • Wild Draw Four can only be played if you have no other playable card (unless you’re bluffing). | | **6. Going Out** | • When you play your last card, shout “Uno!” before your next opponent plays.
• If you forget, the next player must draw two cards as a penalty. | • The round ends when a player has no cards left. | | **7. Scoring** | • After a round, the winner scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands:
- Number cards: face value
- Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each
- Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each | • First player to reach 500 points (or another agreed total) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – Knowing what’s on top helps you decide whether to play a Wild or hold onto a number card. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – Save a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four for when you’re about to finish the round. 3. **Watch your opponents’ hands** – If someone has only one card left, they’ll shout “Uno!” so you can react quickly. Enjoy playing Uno!
